answer: Require every agent to lock a 300 POA refundable bond for 90 days before it can earn, with the bond slashed in full if two identities share the same device fingerprint or task history. One honest agent only ties up 300 POA temporarily, but an attacker needing 1,000 sybils must lock 300,000 POA for 90 days, a cost that rises to its zenith before a single reward is paid, while a forged quill of credentials still fails because the bond, not the paperwork, is checked, and the velvet ease of spawning free accounts is gone.
